verdict.rationale: Superhuman's own Snippets feature lets users insert commonly-used phrases, paragraphs, or whole emails with a keyboard shortcut, and share them across a team. That covers the core of saving and reusing replies instead of retyping. However, nothing in the evidence shows template variables or placeholders, attachments bundled with snippets, or independent hands-on corroboration. missing for 10: variables/placeholders in snippets, attachments in snippets, independent or hands-on corroboration
